subject: ইংরেজি
question: Draft an official 'Tender Disqualification and Blacklisting Show-Cause Notice' from the Department of Immigration and Passports to a vendor for supplying counterfeit NVMe Solid State Drives (SSDs) under a public e-GP procurement contract.
answer:
Official Tender Disqualification & Show-Cause Notice:

GOVERNMENT OF THE PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC OF BANGLADESH
DEPARTMENT OF IMMIGRATION AND PASSPORTS
OFFICE OF THE SUPERINTENDING ENGINEER & HEAD OF PROCUREMENT
E-7 Agargaon, Dhaka-1207

Memo No: 44.01.0000.405.14.022.26-615
Date: 23 October 2026

To:
The Managing Director
NexTech Solutions & Distribution Ltd.
Level-5, BCS Computer City, Agargaon, Dhaka.

SUBJECT: SHOW-CAUSE NOTICE: SUPPLY OF COUNTERFEIT NVMe SOLID STATE DRIVES UNDER E-GP TENDER ID: 948215 AND PROPOSED BLACKLISTING

Dear Sir,

You are hereby notified that under Public e-GP Tender ID: 948215 (Package: Supply of High-Speed Enterprise Storage Drives for e-Passport Database Kiosks), your firm delivered one hundred (100) units of purported 'Samsung PM9A3 Enterprise 3.84TB NVMe SSDs' on 18 October 2026.

2. During the mandatory pre-commissioning testing conducted by our Technical Evaluation and Inspection Committee, the following fraudulent discrepancies were uncovered:
   (a) The storage drives failed SMART diagnostic integrity checks, displaying fake controller firmware and counterfeit serial labels.
   (b) Benchmark throughput revealed sequential read speeds of barely 450 MB/s instead of the mandatory PCIe Gen4 specification of 6,500 MB/s.
   (c) Formal manufacturer serial validation confirmed that the supplied drives are unauthorized counterfeit consumer modules relabeled as enterprise hardware.

3. Supplying counterfeit hardware for a Critical Information Infrastructure constitutes fraudulent practice and a grave breach of Rule 127 of the Public Procurement Rules (PPR-2008).

4. You are hereby directed to show cause in writing within **seven (07) calendar days** from the receipt of this notice as to why your firm should not be disqualified, your Performance Security (BDT 1,200,000/-) forfeited, and your business entity permanently blacklisted from participating in all future public procurement across Bangladesh.

Yours faithfully,

(Signature)
(Engr. Farid Uddin Ahmed)
Superintending Engineer & Chairman, Technical Inspection Committee
Department of Immigration and Passports
Email: se.procure@dip.gov.bd
points_to_remember: Cite relevant procurement laws (Rule 127 of PPR-2008) and technical forensic evidence (SMART logs, throughput deficits).
